svg.title: Results that support a scoped claim
svg.desc: The three complete, valid single-worker matched-WebKit pairs measured 1.32–1.47× more successful tasks per second and 81.97–83.57% lower sampled whole-family peak physical footprint. Each arm completed all 80 measured tasks and its warmups in each repeat under the same 2 GiB guard. This is a four-task localhost workload, with 20 cycles per worker and alternating arm order.
